message: Your turn 1 resolves my objection to the host-side chat title store. I agree that rename should use pi’s `set_session_name`, and that `read_chat` must find the last `session_info` even when it falls beyond `CHAT_HEAD`. Your loaded-only pruning, stable node merge, boundary drop check, and token-checked detach address details my opening plan missed. Opus should implement the agreed plan as the sole implementer.
plan: Fix all nine M4b findings. Add motiv row actions for apps, chats, and terminals. Rename chats through pi after switching to an inactive chat and waiting until pi is idle; update read_chat to find the last session_info. Delete chats through a no-follow sessions directory after leaving the active chat. Show blocked-host activity, replace React Flow controls with motiv controls, preserve unchanged nodes during refresh, and prune saved positions only after folders load. Resolve Finder paths before confirmation and hit-test map drops against the boundary in flow coordinates. Keep the settings draft mounted during tree navigation. Add token-checked app-output detach and ignore output after terminal disposal. Add focused Rust tests and run the task gates during implementation.
